query: Provide explicit definitions and edge‑case rules for each of the six annotation categories and attach at least six annotated exemplars per category for both visual and textual data.

response.query: Provide explicit definitions and edge‑case rules for each of the six annotation categories and attach at least six annotated exemplars per category for both visual and textual data.
response.answer: Six annotation categories: 1) Support, 2) Oppose, 3) Neutral, 4) Question, 5) Clarification, 6) Additional Info. Each has strict rules; exemplars include specific votes or comments.
